remarks: Welcome to Regents Park, the condo you have been waiting for! Walk into a chic, bright & airy 2 B/R 2 1/2 bath condo completely done. Renovated end unit allows lots of privacy. If you are looking to downsize from the "big house" or for the city dwellers that want to explore the gold coast lifestyle of Westport, then here it is - wait no longer. Double entry foyer leads to a beautiful kitchen with skylight, quartz calcutta countertops, stainless steel appliances with a huge restaurant size frig/freezer. Continue into an open dining/living area w/sliders to a back patio and garden for al fresco dining. Living room has a stunning black onyx stone fireplace w/shiplap moulding walls, nearby wet bar & wine cooler for all your entertaining enjoyment. Beautiful custom made window shades add a contemporary flair & ambiance. An updated powder room is conveniently located on first level. Hardwood floors throughout. The custom railing to upper stairway features large wall space to showcase fabulous artwork. Upper level features full side by side W&D & hallway linen closet. Primary vaulted bedroom has a fully remodeled ensuite bathroom w/soaking tub, large shower & double sink vanity w/Carrera marble. Walk-in closet has pull down attic for storage. Second bedroom has two closets & it's own remodeled bathroom. Lower level is completely finished that can be a den/playroom/gym or for guests. Lots of closets. Maintenance free condo living! Located just mins to all that Westport is known for!
